Arrive at Jorge Chávez International Airport in Lima, where we'll meet you and take you to your hotel.

Check in at a 4-star hotel. The rest of the day is free to recover from the flight and prepare for the next leg of the journey. Lima connects several parts of this itinerary: you'll return here after Lake Titicaca and again after visiting the Amazon.
Illuminated cathedral with two towers behind a fountain and red flowerbeds at night, Lima, Peru
Lima at night: the cathedral and fountain in the city square
Lima to Cusco and a city tour

After breakfast, a driver will take you from your hotel to the airport for your flight to Cusco. On arrival, we'll meet you at the airport and take you to your hotel.

After a short rest, join an afternoon sightseeing tour of Cusco by bus. The city stands more than 3,000 metres above sea level and has been linked to the history of the Inca Empire for centuries. According to local tradition, Manco Cápac founded Cusco after arriving from the shores of Lake Titicaca.

The first major stop is Sacsayhuamán, a 15th-century fortress and temple complex. Its walls were built in the Cyclopean style from enormous stone blocks, the largest weighing more than 3,000 tonnes. The blocks were brought from far away and fitted together without conventional mortar.

Next, you'll see Q'enqo, an archaeological site in the Sacred Valley. It resembles an amphitheatre carved into the rock and is associated with Inca religious rites. This part of the route also takes you to Puka Pukara and Tambomachay, with its network of water channels.

Another stop is Qorikancha, the Temple of the Sun and the most important shrine of the Inca Empire. The conquistadors destroyed the temple, and Santo Domingo was built on its foundations. Tradition has it that the walls and interior of Qorikancha were covered in gold, and that a large gold disc inside depicted Inti, the sun god.

**Cusco Cathedral**

An optional visit to Cusco Cathedral takes about 40 minutes and can be arranged before the main tour.

After the tour, return to the hotel to rest and give yourself time to adjust to the altitude.
